_comment: District 9 (GDD §4.1 chain order), FIRST ACT III DISTRICT (GDD §12.3: Act III = D9-11) and the FIRST TWO-PARENT CONVERGENCE: data/districts/district_industrial.tres powered_by = [&"warehouses", &"police"] — GDD §4.3 requires BOTH at FULL, so the guaranteed prerequisite closure is the UNION of both branches: warehouses -> hospital -> residential -> suburbs PLUS police -> park -> suburbs = suburbs, residential, park, hospital, warehouses, police (six districts, all stages). NOT guaranteed: school, gas_station (leaves), substation, power_station (descendants) — the Act III broadcasts radio_02/radio_03 are gated on those and must never spawn here. Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): destroyer, hunter, watcher — DESTROYER leads, and it is the worst lead in the chain so far: no light reaction at all AND it breaks nearby streetlights on patrol (destroyer_3d.gd _try_break_nearby_lights), so light is a spent consumable here, never a tool (R5). Hunter rages x1.3 for 5 s the moment a beam leaves it; watcher rages x1.25 after its 2 s stun. Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): fuse, transistor, gear, metal — the plant that machined the grid's own hardware is its parts bin (lore_notes 03/05). Story doc canon: doc_factory_log ('22:00 strange hum from the generator; 23:15 light in workshop B flickering' — shift log of Factory #9), extended, never copied, by industrial_note_02 (the 23:15 photograph). Blueprint CANON: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS has NO industrial row — exactly four blueprint districts (residential/park/police/warehouses); GDD §9's D9 'Battery L2' workbench is location flavour only (no blueprint_battery_l2 id exists in data/items; same class as police D7 strobe / warehouses D8 workbench) — R7. Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd generator_industrial (reward 2x medkit, power_stage 2). Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Feeder-hall maintenance chest, open from the factory floor; the grid crew's log (industrial_note_03) counted the plant's stores in-world.
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Yard-parts bin by the stores cage — 'fuses by the crate' (industrial_note_03). The crate the crew took from is gone; the bin behind it stayed.

Guarantee: transistor for FULL. The plant's solid-state lives behind the switchgear door ('transistor stock behind the switchgear door' — industrial_note_03). Room locked; opened by industrial_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Switchgear key in the foreman's catwalk office desk, top drawer, unlocked — 'the key will be in the foreman's office, same as the depot' (industrial_note_03). Reachable in DARK with zero tools (R1).
Battery top-up on arrival; the dock office is the district's safe pocket and the plant floor is long sightlines in fog.
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT: metal): billet-stock offcuts in the yard scrap bin. The plant must pay out materials at DARK; non-RNG by R6.
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT: gear): drive gears from the Workshop B bench toolbox — machine spares where the machines were made.
Optional risk-reward salvage: line offcuts and drum stock in the grease pit — deliberately inside the destroyer's patrol (R5), never chain-critical, never required by any rule.
Shift first-aid locker; the plant is press-stroke quiet and nobody is left to patch you up.

Fixed defense cache: the dock office's compressed-air horn test canisters (noise_bomb, STREETS+ — R2). Fire discipline keeps it out of Workshop B, the grease pits and the generator hall (R8); the plant is solvent-soaked.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor): cable in the generator-hall tool chest, fuse in the yard parts bin, transistor in the switchgear cabinet; the switchgear key (industrial_fix_key_01) sits in the foreman's unlocked desk drawer, so the whole chain is reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot. None of the three chain components or the key sits in the destroyer's patrol (factory floor / assembly line pit) — a player who never fights it still finishes.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. fuse and transistor never roll in DARK (the yard bins and the switchgear cabinet are the DARK sources); molotov enters rolls at PARTIAL, noise_bomb at STREETS — mirroring the warehouses/police discipline.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.

R4: No firearms in industrial. There is no pistol/rifle/ammo id in data/items. molotov/noise_bomb remain the combat ceiling; the district pays out parts (fuse/transistor/gear/metal) and lets the generator_industrial puzzle pay 2x medkit (puzzle_system.gd) — medicine, not coins.

R5: DESTROYER-LEADS (enemy_pool.gd [destroyer, hunter, watcher]) — the first district in the chain where light is not even a disengage tool: the destroyer has NO light reaction and BREAKS nearby streetlights while patrolling (destroyer_3d.gd), so every lamp is a consumable the district eats; its cue is the machinery hum audible at 12 m and its weakness is the 5 m / 180-degree sight — cover is machine-footprint spacing, not beams. The hunter slows x0.5 in a flashlight but rages x1.3 for 5 s the instant the beam leaves it (never strobe-and-run); the watcher takes a 2 s stun then rages x1.25 for 5 s, breath audible at 5 m, 15 m scream pulls the whole floor. The DARK chain (R1) never requires light, combat or a chase.
R6: Scripted caches must not roll empty: the switchgear cabinet, the foreman's desk, the yard bins and the dock crate are fixed payouts (mirrors police armory/evidence, warehouses cage/office).

R7: No blueprint in industrial: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon is exactly four districts (residential, park, police, warehouses) — industrial is not one of them. GDD §9's D9 'Battery L2' workbench is location flavour only (no blueprint_battery_l2 id exists in data/items; same class as police's D7 strobe and warehouses' D8 portable workbench). No schematic id may roll or fix-spawn here.

R8: z_switchgear_room never relights at any stage (windowless and locked; read by corridor spill — mirrors police holding cells, warehouses quarantine cage, hospital morgue): no streetlight_3d inside, global relight passes must skip it. The assembly line never lights and never runs audibly at any stage — the sorting line is the district's anomaly (industrial_note_03), not wallpaper; it must never become a sound cue. Fire discipline: no molotov/noise_bomb cache inside z_workshop_b (solvent degreaser), the assembly-line grease pits or z_generator_hall — the district's fixed defense cache is the dock-office air-horn canister.
